title: Tiered Approach for MediSave Withdrawal Limits
what_it_is: Tiered Approach for MediSave Withdrawal Limits

sections.label: MediSave CDMP limits and increases
sections.summary: MediSave500/700 CDMP limits are tiered, and Flexi-MediSave and outpatient scan withdrawal limits will increase in 2025 and 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The MediSave500/700 limits for treatment under the Chronic Disease Management Programme (CDMP) are already tiered.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The lower $500 annual limit caters to patients with a single non-complex chronic condition while the higher $700 annual limit is for those with complex chronic conditions, including those with two or more CDMP chronic conditions.

For older patients aged 60 and above, they will also benefit from the Flexi-MediSave scheme, which allows them to withdraw up to an additional $300 annually for their outpatient medical expenses, including those under CDMP.
This Flexi-MediSave annual limit will be increased from $300 to $400 from 1 October 2025.
The Ministry of Health will also be increasing the annual outpatient scan withdrawal limit from $300 to $600 with effect from 1 January 2026.

sections.label: CDMP limits regularly reviewed
sections.summary: The CDMP limits and chronic diseases covered are regularly revised and reviewed to remain adequate for those who need them.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The limits as well as the chronic diseases that come under the CDMP are regularly revised and reviewed so that we can ensure that they remain adequate for those who need them.
